message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on the damping coefficient and angular velocity.
velocity is the key kinematic quantity that determines this damping term in the pendulum model.
model equations should include it when air resistance or viscous losses are significant.
significant damping means the physical pendulum no longer follows the ideal conservative case.
